WITH Rolling_Window AS
/*
#
# HISTORY
#
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-+
# | Date	 | Author 	  	      |Description                                                				 |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
# | 20250101 | JAY-AR GAVINA      |Initial																	 |
# | 20260116 | ARLAND BINDOY 	  |Removed filter on business_Day_flag for rolling window 					 |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-+
#
*/
(
SELECT * FROM
    (
    SELECT 
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY FullDate DESC) AS RN,
            DD.*,
            EC.CRM_INTEGRATION_DATA,
            EC.CRM_DATE,
            EC.Rolling_Window
    FROM eds.DATE_DIM DD
        INNER JOIN eds.EDS_CTL EC
            ON FULLDATE <= CRM_DATE
    --WHERE Business_Day_Flag = 'Y'
    ) A
--WHERE
--- Last n business days
--    RN <= Rolling_Window
)
SELECT
TOP 100
RW.FullDate AS AS_OF_DATE,
COUNT(*)
FROM Rolling_Window AS RW
    LEFT JOIN eds.CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO AS CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO
        ON CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.Type = 'Currency'
        AND CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
        AND SUBSTRING(CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.ORGKEY, 1, 1) = 'R'
---Fetch all records that per business day (SNAPSHOT)
        AND ((UPPER(RW.CRM_INTEGRATION_DATA) = 'DELTA' AND RW.FullDate = CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.SCD_Start_Date))
    LEFT JOIN eds.CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD AS CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD
        ON CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.ORGKEY = CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD.ORGKEY AND CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.BANK_ID = CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD.BANK_ID
		AND CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD.ACCOUNTID IS NOT NULL 
---Fetch all records per business day (SNAPSHOT)
        AND ((UPPER(RW.CRM_INTEGRATION_DATA) = 'DELTA' AND RW.FullDate = CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD.SCD_Start_Date))
WHERE 
--CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.ACCOUNTID IS NOT NULL
--AND 
(CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.ORGKEY IS NOT NULL OR CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD.ORGKEY IS NOT NULL
--OR (CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.ORGKEY IS NULL AND CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD.ORGKEY IS NULL)
)
GROUP BY RW.FullDate
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
